prompt:
Fix snippets/sample-request-eligibility.liquid, which tells a customer whether their fabric sample request can be fulfilled. Inputs (all top-level variables; there is no section object): - requested: integer, never null. Number of samples requested. - samples_used: integer, never null. Samples the customer already received this month. - monthly_limit: integer, never null. Samples allowed per month. - order_subtotal_cents: integer, never null. - fabric_name: string or null. Output exactly one result, with no whitespace or newlines before, after or between elements. Evaluate the rules in this order; the first matching rule wins: 1. requested is less than 1:

Select at least one sample

2. requested is greater than 5 (exactly 5 is allowed):

You can request at most 5 samples at a time

3. Let REMAINING = monthly_limit minus samples_used, but use 0 if that is negative. If requested is greater than REMAINING (equal is allowed):

Only REMAINING samples left this month

, using the word "sample" instead of "samples" when REMAINING is exactly 1 (0 uses "samples"). 4. Otherwise output:

N samples of FABRIC

SHIPPING
- N is requested; use "sample" when N is exactly 1. - FABRIC is fabric_name with leading/trailing whitespace stripped and HTML-escaped with the escape filter; if fabric_name is null or blank after stripping, use Assorted fabrics. - SHIPPING: if order_subtotal_cents is 5000 or more:

Free sample shipping

. Otherwise the fee in cents is 150 plus 50 times requested, shown as

Sample shipping: $D.CC

where D is the whole dollars and CC is always exactly two digits of cents (e.g. 200 cents is $2.00, 250 cents is $2.50). Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/sample-request-eligibility.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
